using Raw = std::string
class Refusal : public std::runtime_error
  const char* word
  std::size_t offset
enum class Proof {None, Claimed, Invalid, Unsigned, Unmet, Pid, Bound, Kernel, Signed}
inline constexpr std::string_view wire_name(Proof value)
inline std::optional<Proof> parse_proof(std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(Proof value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(Proof value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(std::string_view name, Proof value)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(std::string_view name, Proof value)
inline const std::vector<std::string> kProofNames
inline const std::vector<std::string> kNativeOperations
inline const std::vector<std::string> kNativeBindingTypes
struct ProofRequirement
  Proof user
  Proof process
  Proof path
  Proof package
  Proof code
struct ProofFailure
  std::string attribute
  Proof have
  Proof need
  std::string why
inline std::string encode(const ProofRequirement& v)
inline ProofRequirement decode(std::string_view data)
